captions:
I think I'll just sit here and let the morning take its time today.
Rain streaks the glass, turning the busy world outside into a soft, steady blur of green and grey.

There is absolutely no point in rushing when the day is this steady.
Even the bookstore feels peaceful, giving her space to slowly flip through the pages without any rush.

I completely lost my train of thought, but honestly, I don't even mind.
She pauses to let her thoughts drift, watching the steam rise lazily from her warm mug.

Anti-Knight today — knight moves block matching numbers.
Anti-Knight changes the move, so Isla checks the rule before trusting it.

There we go. That one actually makes sense now.
As the warm evening light fills the kitchen, the pieces of the day finally start coming together.

I'll just leave it there for tonight and enjoy the rest of the evening.
It is nice to simply exist in the steady moments without worrying about what comes next.

co-working desk near a tall window
